name: Hirosoma Rokushou
source:
[url=/c105008]Kikyou's[/url] and [url=/c105012]Shinku's[/url] uncle, who was always nice, brought them candy, and let them play games on his phone. 

[Spoiler]Later revealed to be their good-for-nothing father, who came onto Kikyou and Shinku. Shinku let him have her to protect Kikyou and her memories of their 'uncle'.[/spoiler]
